content.title: USA Rare Earth Takes Off On Merger, White House Talks
content.summary: USA Rare Earth stock broke out on Thursday, then continued to fly higher Friday after new CEO Barbara Humpton confirmed talks with the White House in a CNBC interview.  After federal investments in rare-earth play MP Materials and Lithium Americas lit a fire under those stocks, traders are keen to get ahead of the next deal.  "This is a field where it will not be a zero sum game," Humpton said.

content.title: USA Rare Earth in ‘Close Communication’ With Trump Administration. The Stock Is Rising 24%.
content.summary: Shares of  USA Rare Earth  were climbing sharply Friday after CEO Barbara Humpton told CNBC the rare earth miner was “in close communication” with the Trump administration.  “What we’re doing is keeping the administration informed of our plans, and we expect that partnership to continue,” said Humpton, who took the helm as chief executive on Wednesday.  The answer lifted hopes that  USA Rare Earth  may secure federal government investment.
